title: The Tide Line of Tiny Shells
youtube_title: The Tide Line of Tiny Shells | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Una finds a tide line of tiny shells, none of them needed in a pocket. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Una shows Rafi how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
